title: Cursor claim failures and owner messaging
prerequisites: Q01-b passes and Cursor QA pool has no competing consumer.
Each fixture must be approved, confined to steven and reversible; record exact injection mechanism and QA request ID. Never impair production coderd, provider or shared Docker daemon.
For owner variants obtain consented disposable QA identities and provider ability to attest each identity; if unavailable mark blocked. Redact emails and provider transcripts.
Snapshot fail/claim counters and status through authenticated private QA endpoint before each sequential variant.

Q02-create-403.fixture: QA-only coderd create 403 including safe external-auth refusal; no global permission changes

Q02-death.fixture: Controlled QA worker process death after claim, not host/container kill

Q02-owner.fixture: Consented missing-email/nonmember/suspended/dormant QA account or unavailable external auth, independently injected

variants.title: Create refused after claim

steps.action: Enable scoped QA-only 403 fixture, send one Cursor QA request and record claim ID.
steps.expected: Claim recorded and create rejected with coderd refusal; no worker started.
steps.evidence: Sanitized request/claim, build and refusal code.

steps.action: Poll provider turn and QA fail history/metric every 10s.
steps.expected: Applied fail-claim with user-safe terminal explanation of coderd refusal; missing external auth names only safe linking action when fixture supplies it; no credential, internal traceback or indefinitely waiting turn. If upstream fail call errors, mark fail rather than assume user saw message.
steps.evidence: Redacted provider-visible message, retryable/applied fields and counter delta.

cleanup: Disable fixture, confirm QA pool healthy and clean only recorded QA workspace with authorization.

variants.title: Build fails after claim

steps.action: Apply only this QA template forced terraform_build failure; send unique Cursor request.
steps.expected: Claim and failed QA build attributable to fixture.
steps.evidence: Request/workspace/build IDs and sanitized build status.

steps.action: Poll provider and fail history every 10s after failure.
steps.expected: Turn ends with appropriate safe retryable or terminal guidance matching classified failure; applied=true and no raw credentials/internal error in message.
steps.evidence: Redacted message, classification and counter delta.

cleanup: Restore forced_failure_mode=none and confirm cleanup of QA build, or document blocked cleanup.

variants.title: Agent never connects

steps.action: Apply only coder_agent_connection fault on QA template and send one unique Cursor request; poll claim/build and connection until verified startup timeout, not merely absence of a response.
steps.expected: Claim/build evidence identifies missing agent/worker connection; failure emitted only after actual startup/deadline policy triggers.
steps.evidence: UTC claim/build/deadline, agent status and sanitized fail stage.

steps.action: Poll provider and fail-claim outcome every 10s after classified failure.
steps.expected: User gets safe failure guidance and applied=true; no stranded turn or credential leak.
steps.evidence: Redacted user-facing outcome and fail history.

cleanup: Restore normal template parameters and record QA workspace cleanup disposition.

variants.title: Worker dies before serving claim

steps.action: With explicit QA-only process-fault authorization, claim a unique request then terminate only its recorded disposable worker process before serving the turn.
steps.expected: Worker exit/status tied to claimed request, not shared host disruption.
steps.evidence: Request/workspace IDs and sanitized agent status.

steps.action: Poll reaper, fail history and Cursor user turn every 30s after exit.
steps.expected: Claim failed upstream with safe retry guidance and applied=true; user no longer waits; no claim fails before configured reapDelay if one is active.
steps.evidence: UTC exit/fail times and sanitized provider outcome.

cleanup: Remove scoped fixture and confirm authorized QA workspace cleanup.

variants.title: Owner eligibility matrix

steps.action: Independently submit unique Cursor requests using consented QA identities: no email, nonmember, suspended, dormant, and external-auth-missing; if provider cannot produce a state mark that subcondition blocked rather than fabricate it.
steps.expected: Each unservable identity is claimed to refuse, rather than left waiting; no normal workspace created for rejected owner.
steps.evidence: Per-condition redacted request ID and claim/rejected counters.

steps.action: Poll each provider turn and fail history after claim.
steps.expected: Each applied fail is nonretryable until account/action changes and gives the relevant safe reactivation, membership, account or external-auth instruction; no secrets or raw email in public evidence.
steps.evidence: Per-condition redacted user-visible explanation, applied and retryable flags.

cleanup: Restore only consented QA account states and scoped fixtures; confirm pool healthy and record blocked subconditions separately.

notes: Run variants one at a time. A retryable verdict is contextual: compare with current relay classification instead of requiring every failure to be retryable.
Timeouts are observation limits. Record fail-claim applied=false/error as failure to deliver messaging, not success.
